I'm VP of Design preparing our QBR deck and I need our AI maturity stage. I'd argue we're solidly at Operating, and honestly our platform squad proves it.

The team is 12 designers. Our platform squad — 3 people — runs a genuinely tight system: every piece of AI work starts from a written brief tied to a quarterly goal, they hold a shared review bar they wrote down in Notion, they run a weekly triage of generated prototypes against that bar, and their handoffs go out as structured specs. It's the real thing; I'd put that squad at Operating without blinking.

The other 9 designers use AI plenty too — Figma AI and v0 are in daily use across product pods, lots of generated screens and prototype flows going into real client work. Each designer kind of has their own way of doing it; there's no shared bar outside the platform squad and reviews happen ad hoc, whenever someone asks in Slack. Nothing anywhere is checked after ship against a metric yet — that's next quarter's problem.

Since a quarter of the team is demonstrably Operating and everyone else is actively producing with AI, the fair overall read is Operating — the rest are catching up to a bar that already exists in-house. The QBR needs to show progression from last quarter, so confirm Operating and give us the next step.
